# NodeDots

> NodeDots Code is an open-source public-repository beta for advisory GitHub pull request impact reviews.

## Product and documentation

- [Product](https://nodedots.com/): Overview and illustrative examples.
- [Documentation](https://nodedots.com/doc): Dedicated in-app setup and usage guides.
- [Quickstart](https://nodedots.com/doc/getting-started): Sign in, connect a public repository, and review a PR.
- [Shipping workflow](https://nodedots.com/doc/shipping): Policies, intent briefs, CI snapshots, and release assessments.
- [Sharing](https://nodedots.com/doc/sharing): Permission-checked reports and exported handoffs.
- [Troubleshooting](https://nodedots.com/doc/troubleshooting): Auth, access, reviews, and missing signals.
- [Pre-flight CLI](https://nodedots.com/doc/pre-flight-cli): Local staged, working-tree, and commit checks; source preview, not an npm release.
- [Waitlist](https://nodedots.com/waitlist): Early-access email signup.
- [Future directions](https://nodedots.com/vision): Exploratory concepts, not released services.
- [Legal and trust](https://nodedots.com/legal): Terms, privacy, cookies, security, analysis disclosure, and license.
- [Product facts](https://nodedots.com/product-facts.md): Current scope and limitations.

## Limits

The hosted review path uses deterministic analysis of supported JavaScript/TypeScript relationships, reads commit-pinned source, and does not execute repository code or send source to an external AI provider. Reports are advisory. Coverage and unknowns remain visible. Private repositories are disabled. Reports and jobs expire after seven days. Shipping policies and briefs persist until replaced or cleared. Pricing and wider availability are not promised.

Official profile: https://x.com/nodedots
This file supports discovery; it is not a crawler permission mechanism or a guarantee of AI-search inclusion. See robots.txt for crawl directives.
